name: Qwen 3 4B Instruct
description: Alibaba's Qwen 3 4B Instruct (July 2025) is the default model for chat and document summaries. It answers directly instead of reasoning at length first, calls tools reliably for its size, handles English and Filipino well, and runs comfortably on a CPU-only machine.

name: Qwen 3 1.7B
description: Alibaba's Qwen 3 1.7B is a lightweight model for quick answers on slower machines. It is faster than Qwen 3 4B Instruct but gives shorter, less thorough answers and summaries. CATSight also uses it for short background jobs such as naming chats.
